metadata.description: Create a new property for a specified object type within a given app in the MediaBridge service.
metadata.learn_more: Create a new property for a specified object type within a given app in the MediaBridge service. This endpoint allows you to define new properties that can be used to store additional information related to the object type. The request must include the necessary property details in the request body.

appId.label: App Id
appId.description: The unique identifier of the app where the property will be created.

objectType.label: Object Type
objectType.description: The type of object for which the property is being created.

calculationFormula.label: Calculation Formula
calculationFormula.description: A string representing the formula used to calculate the property's value, applicable for calculated properties.

currencyPropertyName.label: Currency Property Name
currencyPropertyName.description: A string that specifies the name of the property used to determine the currency for currency-type properties.

dataSensitivity.label: Data Sensitivity
dataSensitivity.description: A string indicating the sensitivity level of the data, such as 'PII' (Personally Identifiable Information).

description.label: Description
description.description: A string providing a description of the property, explaining its purpose or usage.

displayOrder.label: Display Order
displayOrder.description: An integer that determines the order in which the property is displayed relative to other properties.

externalOptions.label: External Options
externalOptions.description: A boolean that specifies whether the property options are managed externally.

fieldType.label: Field Type
fieldType.description: A string indicating the field type for the property, such as 'booleancheckbox', 'calculation_equation', 'checkbox', 'date', 'file', 'html', 'number', 'phonenumber', 'radio', 'select', 'text', or 'textarea'.

formField.label: Form Field
formField.description: A boolean indicating whether the property is available for use in forms.

groupName.label: Group Name
groupName.description: The name of the group to which the property belongs, represented as a string.

hasUniqueValue.label: Has Unique Value
hasUniqueValue.description: A boolean indicating whether the property must have a unique value across all records.

hidden.label: Hidden
hidden.description: A boolean that specifies whether the property is hidden from user interfaces.

label.label: Label
label.description: A string representing the display label for the property, used in user interfaces.

name.label: Name
name.description: The unique name of the property. It is a string that identifies the property within the object type.

numberDisplayHint.label: Number Display Hint
numberDisplayHint.description: A string that provides a hint for displaying number properties, such as 'unformatted', 'formatted', 'currency', 'percentage', 'duration', or 'probability'.

options.label: Options
options.description: An array of OptionInput objects, specifying the options available for properties of type 'enumeration'.

referencedObjectType.label: Referenced Object Type
referencedObjectType.description: A string that denotes the object type referenced by the property, if applicable.

showCurrencySymbol.label: Show Currency Symbol
showCurrencySymbol.description: A boolean indicating whether to display a currency symbol for currency-type properties.

textDisplayHint.label: Text Display Hint
textDisplayHint.description: A string that provides a hint for displaying text properties, such as 'unformatted_single_line', 'multi_line', 'email', 'phone_number', 'domain_name', 'ip_address', 'physical_address', or 'postal_code'.

type.label: Type
type.description: The data type of the property, which can be one of 'bool', 'date', 'datetime', 'enumeration', 'number', 'phone_number', or 'string'.
